item.title: Restaurants have long used fake food ads; AI slop is the latest twist
item.description: Generative AI offers restaurants a low-cost alternative to food photography, but customers may prefer an imperfect photo of a real meal.

item.title: After 30 years in aerospace, brothers retire to work at Disney
item.description: Jerry and Peter Wong, now in their 60s, left corporate careers to work as a photographer and ride operator at Disney theme parks.

item.title: ASEAN can still balance US and China on AI, but needs to organize first
item.description: Can ASEAN members leverage both Chinese and Western AI ecosystems to serve their own interests?

item.title: The owners of the Portland WNBA team built their fortune through a swimwear company and a brief NFL stint, leading to a $380 million franchise.
item.description: Alex Bhathal acknowledged that progress will require patience, but noted the team has already exceeded expectations.
